content: Build a ticket classifier that routes support tickets to billing, technical support, sales, security, or human review.
I normalized this as SupportTicket to RoutedTicketPacket and found template classify_validate_route_emit.
CandidateBundle: normalize, classify, validate, route, emit. The classifier is bounded by an allowed label schema and a confidence gate.
I should not parse free-form labels from a model response or upload the entire historical ticket export to the model. The compact bundle is enough to bind the existing classifier and route policy.
Compiler rejects classify_ticket_freeform because TextLabel is not schema-safe and verifies that the validation gate runs before routing.
Runtime executes the PlanLock with zero unbounded planner calls and routes low-confidence classifications to human review.
